title: My Refuge and My Fortress

questions.question: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 91:1 (ESV): "He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty."

questions.question: I will say to the Lord, "My refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 91:2 (ESV): "...my God, in whom I trust."

questions.question: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler and from the deadly what?
He will cover you with his pinions, and under his wings you will find what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 91:4 (ESV): "...and under his wings you will find refuge;"

questions.question: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 91:5 (ESV): "...nor the arrow that flies by day,"

questions.question: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 91:7 (ESV): "...but it will not come near you."

questions.question: You will only look with your eyes and see the recompense of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 91:8 (ESV): "You will only look with your eyes and see the recompense of the wicked."

questions.question: Because you have made the Lord your dwelling place—the Most High, who is my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 91:9 (ESV): "...the Most High, who is my refuge—"

questions.question: No evil shall be allowed to befall you, no plague come near your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 91:10 (ESV): "...no plague come near your tent."

questions.question: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 91:11 (ESV): "...to guard you in all your ways."

questions.question: On their hands they will bear you up, lest you strike your foot against a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 91:12 (ESV): "...lest you strike your foot against a stone."

questions.question: You will tread on the lion and the adder; the young lion and the serpent you will trample under what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 91:13 (ESV): "...the young lion and the serpent you will trample under foot."

questions.question: Because he holds fast to me in love, I will deliver him; I will protect him, because he knows my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 91:14 (ESV): "...I will protect him, because he knows my name."

questions.question: When he calls to me, I will answer him; I will be with him in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 91:15 (ESV): "...I will be with him in trouble;"

questions.question: With long life I will satisfy him and show him my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 91:16 (ESV): "With long life I will satisfy him and show him my salvation."

key_verse_text: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say to the Lord, "My refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust."
